narrativeVariants.npc.ser_aldous_fenn.status == 'dead':
The battlefield has been cleared badly. There are still bootprints in the mud, broken arrows under the grass, and a kettle boiling over a fire no one remembers to tend. You take the night watch beside the space where Aldous should have been.

You remember a man in a tavern calling you Aldric's pup. You remember Aldous saying grief was not the same thing as disorder. The silence is the answer to every question you did not ask in time.

Far north, someone begins singing in a language you do not know. The tune carries over the dark fields like a promise neither army has earned.
